name: Concentric Service Model
subtitle: Platform Ecosystem Architecture for Community-Based Organizations
description: A Platform Ecosystem Diagram showing how the platform wraps community touchpoints around a cyclical engagement engine (CONNECT → ENGAGE → SERVE), with data flowing through an ecosystem network to a central data layer.
designPrinciples: Clockwise flow suggests continuous improvement cycle
Halftone dots represent data/influence emanating outward
Reversed wave animation shows inbound flow (community → platform)
Bidirectional API arrows show two-way data exchange
Near-black typography for maximum contrast and readability

layers.name: Community Connection Layer
layers.description: The front door - where the community already lives (phone, text, web, social)

layers.name: CONNECT → ENGAGE → SERVE
layers.description: The cyclical engine - continuous relationship, not linear process

layers.name: Ecosystem Network Layer
layers.description: The partner mesh - food banks, housing, healthcare, benefits systems

layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: Live nervous system - bidirectional data flows for compliance and integration

layers.name: Data Center
layers.description: Single source of truth - client history, interaction logs, outcome tracking

author: Christopher Berno
